def merge_counted(left, right):
    result = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    comparisons = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        comparisons += 1
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            result.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            result.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    result.extend(left[i:])
    result.extend(right[j:])
    return result, comparisons

def merge_sort(values):
    if len(values) <= 1:
        return values.copy(), 0
    mid = len(values) // 2
    left, left_count = merge_sort(values[:mid])
    right, right_count = merge_sort(values[mid:])
    result, merge_count = merge_counted(left, right)
    return result, left_count + right_count + merge_count
print(merge_sort([4, 1, 3, 2]))
print(merge_sort([]))
